log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

log_file.description: Path to the compute agent log file.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

pollsters.description: List of pollster names to enable for metering. Each pollster collects a specific metric.

polling_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between polling cycles for metrics.

polling_interval_resource.description: Interval (in seconds) for discovering new instances/resources to poll.

compute_driver.description: Hypervisor driver to use (e.g., libvirt.LibvirtDriver, vmwareapi.VMwareVCDriver).

instance_discovery_method.description: Method for discovering instances: libvirt_events, polling, or none.

inspector_uri.description: URI for connecting to the hypervisor inspector (e.g., qemu://localhost/system).

inspector_type.description: Inspector type: libvirt, nova, xenapi, or vmwareapi.

notification_topics.description: List of topics to subscribe for notifications from other OpenStack services.

rabbit_host.description: Hostname or IP of RabbitMQ server.

rabbit_virtual_host.description: Virtual host to use in RabbitMQ.

endpoint_type.description: Endpoint type for Nova/Keystone services: publicURL, internalURL, or adminURL.

auth_ssl_verify.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates when connecting to Keystone.

auth_ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for Keystone SSL verification (optional).

service_credentials.description: Keystone service credentials (e.g., os_username, os_password, os_project_name, etc.).

transport_url.description: Message bus transport URL (e.g., 'rabbit://user:pass@host:5672/'). Overrides rabbit_* settings.

pipeline_cfg_file.description: Path to pipeline configuration file defining meters and sources.

transform_cfg_file.description: Path to sample transformation configuration file (optional).

credential_refresh_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) to refresh authentication credentials.

use_local.description: Whether to use local metadata (e.g., libvirt XML) instead of Nova API.

cpu_polling_enabled.description: Enable polling of CPU metrics for instances.

network_polling_enabled.description: Enable polling of network metrics for instances.

disk_polling_enabled.description: Enable polling of disk I/O metrics for instances.

memory_polling_enabled.description: Enable polling of memory metrics for instances.

instance_disk_polling_enabled.description: Enable polling of instance disk usage (GB, iops).

instance_network_polling_enabled.description: Enable polling of per-instance network traffic (bytes in/out).

polling_workers.description: Number of worker processes for polling tasks.

polling_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for each polling operation.

polling_retries.description: Number of retries before a polling operation is considered failed.

instance_discovery_enabled.description: Enable automatic discovery of new compute instances for metering.

instance_discovery_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between instance discovery scans.

libvirt_event_callback_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for libvirt event callbacks.

libvirt_event_callback_retries.description: Max retries for libvirt event callbacks.

libvirt_event_callback_retry_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) between libvirt event callback retries.

libvirt_event_callback_buffer_size.description: Size of the libvirt event callback event buffer.

libvirt_event_callback_max_events.description: Max events processed per cycle from libvirt event stream.
